title: Quad Core Fused Clapton Premade Coils 0.26 Ohm
description: The Wotofo framed Staple Clapton coils are constructed from N80 and Kanthal wire for powerful electrical conductivity, even heat distribution and amazingly-pure flavour. Exquisitely manufactured from the highest-quality materials, the Framed Staple coils are extremely durable and long-lasting, significantly reducing the frequency with which you need to change your heating wire. Rated at 0.33ohms for sumptuous, satisfying sub ohm vaping.
